description: Kiawah, Seabrook or Johns Island: the last 12 months of residential sales island-wide from the MLS's own statistics (every island). Kiawah and Seabrook add home sales from 2021-01-01 to the last pull (2026-10-14), checked month by month against the MLS's own statistics: the last 12 months, each year's price per square foot and price-cut share, each price band's days on market and months of supply, and what cutting the price has meant for sellers.
